tasks.subject: Task 6: Checkout + Razorpay Webhook
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Checkout API (stock check → order → Razorpay order). Webhook (HMAC verify → PAYMENT_CONFIRMED → Resend → Shiprocket). Cancel endpoint.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/api/checkout/route.ts`, `app/api/checkout/cancel/route.ts`, `app/api/razorpay/webhook/route.ts`
- Test: `__tests__/api/checkout.test.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 409 when any cart item out of stock
- [ ] Creates Order (PENDING) + Razorpay order
- [ ] Webhook rejects invalid HMAC with 400
- [ ] Webhook → PAYMENT_CONFIRMED, clears cart, books Shiprocket, sends email
- [ ] Cancel endpoint restores stock

**Verify:** `npx jest __tests__/api/checkout.test.ts` → all pass

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/api/checkout/route.ts","app/api/checkout/cancel/route.ts","app/api/razorpay/webhook/route.ts"], "verifyCommand": "npx jest __tests__/api/checkout.test.ts", "acceptanceCriteria": ["409 on out-of-stock","Order+Razorpay order created","Invalid HMAC rejected","Order→PAYMENT_CONFIRMED","Cancel restores stock"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Shiprocket Webhook + Cron
tasks.description:

**Files:**
- Create: `app/api/courier/webhook/route.ts`, `app/api/cron/release-stock/route.ts`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] 'Delivered' → Order→DELIVERED + delivery email
